show.description:
Tilottama is a witch driven by an insatiable hunger to spend nights with men. But she preys only on those men who, despite having wives at home, fall into the snare of Tilottama’s beauty.

Every full-moon night, when the moon rises in the sky and the flowers on the trees of Rooppur begin to turn from white to red, the villagers understand that Tilottama has claimed her victim. A strange silence envelops the village, and people shut themselves inside their homes.
